Loyal Bond is a 100-piece jigsaw puzzle of a man and his dog, cheek to cheek in a bold portrait set against a bright, painterly backdrop of pink, blue and gold. It's frameable when finished.

It's made for dog lovers and anyone who knows that kind of trust. Do it on a quiet evening with the dog at your feet, or give it to the dog person in your life just because.
